## What's new in 1.2

- **Ten new worlds, twenty in all:** Sundown (rebuilt), Lanternmere, Moonwake, Gloamwood, Velocity, Spirit Grove, Fold, Windsweep, Megacity and Ringworld. The world picker shows a still of each one and marks the new ones until you visit. Frostkeep, Moonspire, Hanami, Lagoon and Hollow Pines are retired; if you were using one, Iris opens in Wine-Dark Sea.
- **Discover** replaces For You: right adds a title to Up Next, left skips it, up means you've seen it, and you can rewind.
- **Friends:** profiles only friends can see, shared critiques (hide any you like), likes and replies, a feed, favourites and masterpieces, a taste match, and sending a friend a title.
- **Accounts** with an emailed code, and a profile picture from the worlds or your own.
- **Sync:** your critiques, Up Next and swipes follow you to another computer when you sign in.
- **Automatic details** from TMDB, IGDB and Wikipedia.

**Mac (Apple silicon):** download `Iris-mac-arm64.dmg`, drag Iris into Applications and open it. The first time, macOS will stop it: go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and click **Open Anyway**.

**Windows:** download `Iris-Setup-win-x64.exe` (or the portable version). If SmartScreen appears, click **More info** → **Run anyway**.

Coming from Marquee? Iris brings your critiques, watchlist and posters across the first time it opens.
